_comment: model_version: the hub metadata model_version for this model; calibration: spread multipliers around the median for horizons 0-3, per target; refit: retrain on all windows after early stopping; ed_model: "obshyb" submits the ED target from the DMAPRIME-ObsHYB networks (the Flu MetroCast model) instead of this model, except where they have no forecast; "hyb" or absent: this model; val: early stopping per target, "recent" (default, the last 8 anchor weeks) or "last_season" (the previous season's October-May), a list trains every seed with each and averages them
